data.gender_notes: Hukmaram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hukmaram is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Hukm' meaning command, order, rule or law and 'Maram' meaning death or mortal. This name signifies that the person is someone who carries the command of God or is someone who is ruling by the command of God. The name Hukmaram carries the meaning “God's command” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Hukmaram usually hope their child will grow to embody god's command and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, who are the givers of wisdom, power and luck.
data.etymology: Hukmaram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's command.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hukmaram total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
